<pasted_content id="da36">
# Issue Description

## Summary
Allow users to change the order in which pages appear in the page navigation interface. Allow users to organize pages into folders or collapsible groups.

## User Story
**As a** user, **I want** reorder and file pages **so that** I can better organize pages

## User Scenario
1. Open page menu.
2. Hold Shift left click on page tab to drag and drop the order user prefer. User can input a number in the page tab menu to immediately move the current page to that spot. 
3. Hold Shift and right-click to select a page, select multiple pages and press ui button to create folder.
4. Name folder
5. Folder moves to the end of the page menu tab list, can still be reorder like page.

---

# Issue Classification

## Scope

**Generic:** Small
**Specific:** Small (3 points)
**Reason:** Allow page order to be swapped around in tab menu.

---

# Expectations

## Acceptance Criteria

## **Acceptance Criteria**

 - [ ] **Criteria A: Reorder Pages:** Users can hold Shift and left-click a page tab to drag and drop it into a new position in the page navigation menu. Users can also enter a numerical position through the page tab menu to move the selected page directly to that position, with the order updating immediately.
 - [ ] **Criteria B: Create Page Folders:** Users can hold Shift and right-click page tabs to select multiple pages, then use a UI button to group the selected pages into a folder. Users must be able to assign a name to the newly created folder.
 - [ ] **Criteria C: Organize Folders:** Newly created folders appear at the end of the page navigation list and can be reordered using the same drag-and-drop interaction as individual pages. Users can expand and collapse folders to show or hide their contained pages.
 - [ ] **Criteria D: Enter number too high:** If the user inputs a number higher than the number of pages than the page will just be moved to the end.
 - [ ] **Criteria E: Enter number too low:** If the user inputs zero, then the page will just be moved to the start. (As if 1 was entered.)
 - [ ] **Criteria F: Enter invalid input** If the user inputs a negative number or something that is not a number, then the page will not move. With a quick notification that the input is invalid

## Open Question

N/A

---

# Extra

## Out of Scope

  - Creating Pages
  - Page navigation
  - Deleting Pages
  - Clearing Pages.
  - Duplicating pages
  - Changing page name and data
  - Transfering elements between pages or copying element from one page to another
  - Importing or exporting multiple pages
  - saving and loading multipe pages
  - making old excalidraw drawning turn into one page whiteboard
  - adding live collab
  - page specific undo/redo

## Head Issue

Issue (#149): Multiple pages in one drawing

## Dependencies
Issue #157

61	/**
62	 * Removes the given pages. If the active page is removed, the closest
63	 * surviving page before it becomes active (or the first one after it).
64	 * Removing every page leaves a single fresh blank page.
65	 */
66	export const deletePages = (
67	  pages: readonly DrawingPage[],
68	  pageIds: readonly string[],
69	  activePageId: string,
70	  generateId: () => string,
71	): { pages: readonly DrawingPage[]; activePageId: string } => {
72	  const toDelete = new Set(pageIds);
73	  if (!toDelete.size) {
74	    throw new Error("No pages selected for deletion");
75	  }
76	  for (const id of toDelete) {
77	    if (!pages.some((page) => page.id === id)) {
78	      throw new Error(`Cannot delete unknown page ${id}`);
79	    }
80	  }
81	  const activeIndex = pages.findIndex((page) => page.id === activePageId);
82	  if (activeIndex === -1) {
83	    throw new Error(`Active page ${activePageId} does not exist`);
84	  }
85	
86	  const remaining = pages.filter((page) => !toDelete.has(page.id));
87	  if (!remaining.length) {
88	    const page = createPage(generateId());
89	    return { pages: [page], activePageId: page.id };
90	  }
91	  if (!toDelete.has(activePageId)) {
92	    return { pages: remaining, activePageId };
93	  }
94	  const previous = pages
95	    .slice(0, activeIndex)
96	    .reverse()
97	    .find((page) => !toDelete.has(page.id));
98	  // no survivor before the active page => remaining[0] is the first after it
99	  return { pages: remaining, activePageId: (previous ?? remaining[0]).id };
100	};
101	
102	/**
103	 * Parses 1-based page positions like "2-4, 7" into page ids (in page order).
104	 * Returns null for anything invalid: empty input, non-numbers, zero,
105	 * out-of-range positions, or reversed ranges like "4-2".
106	 */
107	export const parsePageRange = (
108	  input: string,
109	  pages: readonly DrawingPage[],
110	): string[] | null => {
111	  const tokens = input.split(",").map((token) => token.trim());
112	  const positions = new Set<number>();
113	  for (const token of tokens) {
114	    const match = /^(\d+)(?:\s*-\s*(\d+))?$/.exec(token);
115	    if (!match) {
116	      return null;
117	    }
118	    const start = Number(match[1]);
119	    const end = match[2] === undefined ? start : Number(match[2]);
120	    if (start < 1 || end > pages.length || start > end) {
121	      return null;
122	    }
123	    for (let position = start; position <= end; position++) {
124	      positions.add(position);
125	    }
126	  }
127	  return pages
128	    .filter((_, index) => positions.has(index + 1))
129	    .map((page) => page.id);
130	};

<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**Page labels are currently computed from position ("Page {index+1}" in pages.ts getPageLabel). After a reorder, what should a moved page be called?**

Options:
- **Stable number (Recommended)** - Each page keeps the number it got when created (e.g. 'Page 3' stays 'Page 3' after moving to the top). Reorders are clearly visible. Range select ("2-4") keeps working by position, and I'd show the position next to each tab so the two stay clear.
- **Follow position** - Labels renumber to match the new order (moved page becomes 'Page 1'). Simpler, but a reorder only shows up through the thumbnails, and the existing tests that look up tabs by name keep working unchanged.

**There's no per-page menu today. Where should the 'move to position' number input go?**

Options:
- **Actions area (Recommended)** - A 'Move current page to: [ n ] Move' row under Add page / clearing / deleting buttons. It acts on the active page, matching the scenario's 'move the current page'.
- **Per-tab menu** - A small ⋯ button on each page tab that opens a popover with the number input. More UI, but it can move any page.


**Answer:** Stable number (Recommended), Actions area (Recommended)
</details></tool-use>

# Issue #162 — Reorder pages and group them into folders

## Context
Pages (#149/#157) live in `App` as a flat `this.pages: DrawingPage[]`. Their order is fixed at creation, and labels come from position (`getPageLabel` → `Page {index+1}`). Users want to reorder pages (Shift+drag, or type a position number) and group pages into named folders that can be collapsed. Work stays on `feat/issue-162-page-reorder`, which is currently at master. Other unmerged PRs (e.g. #160 page naming) are ignored, and conflicts get resolved later.

Decisions (confirmed with user):
- **Stable labels:** each page keeps the number it got at creation (`Page 3` stays `Page 3` after a move).
- **Move-to-position input** goes in the Pages actions area and acts on the **current (active) page**.

## Data model (`packages/excalidraw/pages.ts`)
- `DrawingPage` gains `number: number`. `createPage(id, number)`. `getPageLabel(page)` returns `` `${t("labels.page")} ${page.number}` ``. `deletePages`' "fresh page" uses number 1.
- New nav tree types:
  ```ts
  type PageFolder = Readonly<{ type: "folder"; id: string; name: string; collapsed: boolean; pageIds: readonly string[] }>;
  type PageNavNode = Readonly<{ type: "page"; pageId: string }> | PageFolder;
  type PageTree = readonly PageNavNode[];
  type PageNavRef = { type: "page"; id: string } | { type: "folder"; id: string };
  ```
- `this.pages` is always kept in the tree's **flattened order**, so all existing index-based code keeps working (range select, delete fallback, clearing).
- Pure helpers, each returning new values and throwing on unknown ids (the same style as `deletePages`):
  - `getPageOrder(tree): string[]` flattens the tree. `orderPages(pages, tree)` sorts pages to match it.
  - `syncPageTree(tree, pages)` appends new pages at the top level, drops ids that no longer exist, and removes folders left empty. It runs after create and delete.
  - `parsePagePosition(input): number | null` accepts trimmed `/^\d+$/` only. Negatives, decimals, text and empty input give `null` (Criteria F).
  - `movePageToPosition(tree, pageId, position)` works within the page's own list: the top level (a folder counts as one slot) or the folder that holds the page. `0` is clamped to 1 (E) and anything above the list length goes to the end (D).
  - `moveNavItem(tree, dragged, target, placement: "before" | "after")` places the dragged item next to the target, in the target's list. Pages can move into or out of folders this way. A folder dropped next to a page inside a folder lands next to that folder instead, so folders never nest. Dropping an item on itself does nothing.
  - `createPageFolder(tree, pageIds, folderId, name)` pulls the pages out of where they are now, in flattened order. It appends the folder **at the end** of the top level, expanded (Criteria B/C), and prunes folders left empty.
  - `togglePageFolder(tree, folderId)` flips `collapsed`.

## App wiring (`packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx`)
- New fields `private pageTree: PageTree` and `private nextPageNumber`. The constructor builds the first page as number 1 and the tree from it.
- `createPage` uses `nextPageNumber++`. `deletePages` follows up with `syncPageTree`. When the result is a single fresh page, reset `nextPageNumber` to 2.
- Private helper `applyPageTree(tree)` sets `pageTree`, reorders `this.pages` via `orderPages`, then calls `triggerRender()`. The scene is untouched, so there are no history changes.
- New handlers, all of which do nothing when `viewModeEnabled`:
  - `movePageToPosition(input: string)`: if `parsePagePosition` returns null → `this.setToast({ message: t("errors.invalidPagePosition") })` and nothing moves (F). Otherwise move `activePageId`.
  - `moveNavItem(dragged, target, placement)`, `createPageFolder(pageIds, name)` (id from `nanoid()`, name trimmed and required), `togglePageFolder(id)`.
- Pass `pageTree` and the handlers through `LayerUI.tsx` (props interface plus `<Pages>` at about line 492), following the existing `onPage*` prop pattern.

## UI (`packages/excalidraw/components/Pages.tsx`, `Pages.scss`)
- Render from `pageTree` instead of `pages.map`. Look up page objects by id, and use `getPageLabel(page)` everywhere, which replaces the inline `` `${t("labels.page")} ${index + 1}` `` at line 199. Pages inside a folder are indented.
- **Folder header:** a button with a chevron, the folder name and its page count, with `aria-expanded`. Clicking it toggles collapse (C). Collapsed folders hide their pages.
- **Shift+drag (A/C), pointer-based so it only triggers with Shift:**
  - `onPointerDown` on a page tab or folder header with `shiftKey && button === 0` sets local `drag` state.
  - `onPointerMove` over an item sets `dropTarget` with before/after from `clientY` against the middle of the item's box.
  - A `window` `pointerup` commits through `onMoveNavItem`. `Escape` or pointer cancel aborts the drag.
  - Classes `--dragging`, `--drop-before` and `--drop-after` show where the item will land. A click with Shift held does not switch pages.
- **Folder selection (B):** `onContextMenu` with `shiftKey` on a page tab calls `preventDefault` and toggles the page in local `folderSelection` state (class `--folder-selected`, `aria-selected`). Without Shift the existing behavior is unchanged.
  - While the selection is non-empty, a row appears: "{n} pages selected", a name `<input>` (prefilled "Folder {k}", trimmed and required), **Create folder** and **Cancel**. Creating clears the selection.
- **Move row (A/D/E/F):** in the normal (non-clearing) actions: "Move current page to" with a number `<input type="text" inputMode="numeric">` and a **Move** button, inside a `<form>` so Enter submits. The input clears after a valid move.
- All of this is disabled in view mode and hidden in clearing/deleting mode. In clearing/deleting mode the same tree renders, but page items are checkboxes as they are today.
- `locales/en.json` gets new keys:
  - `labels`: `movePageTo`, `folderName`, `pagesSelectedForFolder`, `expandFolder`, `collapseFolder`
  - `buttons`: `movePage`, `createFolder`, `cancelFolder`
  - `errors.invalidPagePosition`: "Enter a page position of 0 or more"

## Tests
- `packages/excalidraw/pages.test.ts`, unit tests:
  - `parsePagePosition`: valid, `0`, negative, decimal, text and empty input
  - `movePageToPosition`: middle, 0 → first, too high → last, inside a folder
  - `moveNavItem`: before/after, into and out of a folder, a folder near a page inside a folder, a no-op on itself
  - `createPageFolder`: lands at the end, pulls pages from other folders, prunes empty folders
  - `syncPageTree` after delete and create
  - `getPageOrder` / `orderPages`
  - stable `getPageLabel`
- `packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx`, integration tests:
  - Shift+pointer drag reorders, and the labels stay stable
  - The move input: valid, `0`, `99`, `-1` and `abc` (a toast appears and the order is unchanged)
  - Shift+right-click on two pages, name the folder and create it: the folder is last, then collapse and expand it
  - Drag a folder
  - Deleting every page in a folder removes the folder
  - The page range select still works by position
- Update existing tests that call `createPage(id)` so they pass a number.

## Verification
1. `yarn test:typecheck`
2. `yarn test:update`. Both pages test files must pass, along with snapshot updates if any.
3. `yarn fix`
4. Manual check with `yarn start`. Open the Pages sidebar, add 4 pages, then:
   - Shift+drag a page; type 0, 99, -1 and "x" in the move box
   - Shift+right-click 2 pages, name the folder and create it, then collapse and expand it
   - Shift+drag the folder
   - Delete a page that is inside a folder
5. Commit in the repo style, e.g. `feat(editor): page reordering and folders (#162)`. Add an AI log under `ai-logs/` following the existing sprint convention.

import { createPage, deletePages, parsePageRange } from "./pages";

import type { DrawingPage } from "./pages";

const makePages = (...ids: string[]) => ids.map((id) => createPage(id));
const ids = (pages: readonly DrawingPage[]) => pages.map((page) => page.id);
const noNewId = () => {
  throw new Error("should not create a page");
};

describe("deletePages", () => {
  const pages = makePages("a", "b", "c", "d");

  it("removes a non-active page and keeps the active page", () => {
    const result = deletePages(pages, ["c"], "a", noNewId);
    expect(ids(result.pages)).toEqual(["a", "b", "d"]);
    expect(result.activePageId).toBe("a");
  });

  it("moves to the previous page when the active page is deleted", () => {
    const result = deletePages(pages, ["c"], "c", noNewId);
    expect(ids(result.pages)).toEqual(["a", "b", "d"]);
    expect(result.activePageId).toBe("b");
  });

  it("skips deleted neighbours to find the closest surviving previous page", () => {
    const result = deletePages(pages, ["b", "c"], "c", noNewId);
    expect(result.activePageId).toBe("a");
  });

  it("moves to the next page when the deleted active page was first", () => {
    const result = deletePages(pages, ["a"], "a", noNewId);
    expect(result.activePageId).toBe("b");
  });

  it("moves to the next surviving page when everything before it is deleted", () => {
    const result = deletePages(pages, ["a", "b", "c"], "b", noNewId);
    expect(ids(result.pages)).toEqual(["d"]);
    expect(result.activePageId).toBe("d");
  });
import React from "react";
import {
  act,
  configure,
  fireEvent,
  waitFor,
  within,
} from "@testing-library/react";

import {
  CANVAS_SEARCH_TAB,
  DEFAULT_SIDEBAR,
  KEYS,
  LIBRARY_SIDEBAR_TAB,
} from "@excalidraw/common";

import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/element";

import "@excalidraw/utils/test-utils";

import {
  cleanAppStateForExport,
  clearAppStateForDatabase,
  clearAppStateForLocalStorage,
  getDefaultAppState,
} from "../appState";
import { activeConfirmDialogAtom } from "../components/ActiveConfirmDialog";
import { PAGES_SIDEBAR_TAB } from "../components/DefaultSidebar";
import { editorJotaiStore } from "../editor-jotai";
import { DefaultSidebar, Excalidraw, Sidebar } from "../index";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";
import { Keyboard } from "./helpers/ui";
import { render, unmountComponent } from "./test-utils";

import type { DrawingPage } from "../pages";

const { h } = window;

configure({ asyncUtilTimeout: 5000 });

// page state and actions are private on App; the UI for deletion comes later
type PageInternals = {
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[];
  activePageId: string;
  createPage: () => void;
  deletePages: (pageIds: readonly string[]) => void;
};
const pageInternals = () => h.app as unknown as PageInternals;
const liveIds = () =>
  window.h.elements
    .filter((element) => !element.isDeleted)
    .map((element) => element.id);

const getConfirmDialog = () =>
  within(document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".confirm-dialog")!);

describe("pages", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    unmountComponent();
    localStorage.clear();
    // the confirm dialog atom lives in a store shared by all editors,
    // so a dialog left open by one test would leak into the next one
    editorJotaiStore.set(activeConfirmDialogAtom, null);
  });

@use "../css/variables.module" as *;

.excalidraw {
  // let the sidebar's flex chain shrink to the sidebar's height so the page
  // list (rather than the whole sidebar) overflows and scrolls
  .sidebar-tabs-root:has(> .page-navigation-tab[data-state="active"]) {
    min-height: 0;
  }

  .page-navigation-tab {
    min-height: 0;
  }

  .page-navigation {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    gap: 1rem;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 0 0.75rem;
  }

  .page-navigation__list {
    display: flex;

import { t } from "../i18n";
import { getPageLabel } from "../pages";

import ConfirmDialog from "./ConfirmDialog";

import type { DrawingPage } from "../pages";

export const PageDeleteDialog = ({
  pages,
  pageIds,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: {
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[];
  pageIds: readonly string[];
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) => {
  const labels = pages.flatMap((page, index) =>
    pageIds.includes(page.id) ? [getPageLabel(page, index)] : [],
  );

  return (
    <ConfirmDialog
      title={t("deletePagesDialog.title")}
      confirmText={t("labels.delete")}
      onConfirm={onConfirm}
      onCancel={onCancel}
    >
      <p>{t("deletePagesDialog.message", { pages: labels.join(", ") })}</p>
      {labels.length === pages.length && (
        <p>{t("deletePagesDialog.allPagesNote")}</p>
      )}
    </ConfirmDialog>
  );
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Page order and folders (#162)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type PageFolder = Readonly<{
  type: "folder";
  id: string;
  name: string;
  collapsed: boolean;
  pageIds: readonly string[];
}>;

export type PageNavNode = Readonly<{ type: "page"; pageId: string }> | PageFolder;

/**
 * What the page navigation shows, top to bottom. Folders hold pages only
 * (never other folders). Flattening it gives the order of `pages`.
 */
export type PageTree = readonly PageNavNode[];

/** A page tab or a folder header in the page navigation. */
export type PageNavRef = Readonly<{ type: "page" | "folder"; id: string }>;

export type PageDropPlacement = "before" | "after";

export const createPageTree = (pages: readonly DrawingPage[]): PageTree =>
  pages.map((page) => ({ type: "page", pageId: page.id }));

/** Page ids in navigation order, with folder contents in place. */
export const getPageOrder = (tree: PageTree): string[] =>
  tree.flatMap((node) => (node.type === "page" ? [node.pageId] : node.pageIds));

/** Sorts `pages` into the tree's order. The tree must hold exactly these pages. */
export const orderPages = (
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[],
  tree: PageTree,
): DrawingPage[] => {
  const order = getPageOrder(tree);
  if (order.length !== pages.length) {
    throw new Error("Page tree and pages are out of sync");
  }
  const byId = new Map(pages.map((page) => [page.id, page]));
  return order.map((id) => {
    const page = byId.get(id);
    if (!page) {
      throw new Error(`Page tree references unknown page ${id}`);
    }
    return page;
  });
};

const pruneEmptyFolders = (tree: PageTree): PageTree =>
  tree.filter((node) => node.type === "page" || node.pageIds.length > 0);

/**
 * Brings the tree in line with `pages`: drops pages that no longer exist
 * (and folders left empty), and appends new pages at the end.
 */
export const syncPageTree = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[],
): PageTree => {
  const pageIds = new Set(pages.map((page) => page.id));
  const kept = pruneEmptyFolders(
    tree.flatMap((node): PageNavNode[] => {
      if (node.type === "page") {
        return pageIds.has(node.pageId) ? [node] : [];
      }
      return [
        { ...node, pageIds: node.pageIds.filter((id) => pageIds.has(id)) },
      ];
    }),
  );
  const inTree = new Set(getPageOrder(kept));
  return [
    ...kept,
    ...pages
      .filter((page) => !inTree.has(page.id))
      .map((page): PageNavNode => ({ type: "page", pageId: page.id })),
  ];
};

const assertPageInTree = (tree: PageTree, pageId: string) => {
  if (!getPageOrder(tree).includes(pageId)) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown page ${pageId}`);
  }
};

const findFolder = (tree: PageTree, folderId: string): PageFolder => {
  const folder = tree.find(
    (node): node is PageFolder => node.type === "folder" && node.id === folderId,
  );
  if (!folder) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown page folder ${folderId}`);
  }
  return folder;
};

/** The folder holding the page, or null if the page is at the top level. */
export const getPageFolder = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pageId: string,
): PageFolder | null => {
  assertPageInTree(tree, pageId);
  return (
    tree.find(
      (node): node is PageFolder =>
        node.type === "folder" && node.pageIds.includes(pageId),
    ) ?? null
  );
};

/** Removes the page wherever it is, keeping any folder it leaves empty. */
const removePage = (tree: PageTree, pageId: string): PageTree =>
  tree.flatMap((node): PageNavNode[] => {
    if (node.type === "page") {
      return node.pageId === pageId ? [] : [node];
    }
    return node.pageIds.includes(pageId)
      ? [{ ...node, pageIds: node.pageIds.filter((id) => id !== pageId) }]
      : [node];
  });

const insertAt = <T>(list: readonly T[], index: number, item: T): T[] => [
  ...list.slice(0, index),
  item,
  ...list.slice(index),
];

/**
 * Parses a 1-based target position. Zero is allowed (it means "first");
 * negatives, decimals, text and empty input are invalid and give null.
 */
export const parsePagePosition = (input: string): number | null => {
  const trimmed = input.trim();
  return /^\d+$/.test(trimmed) ? Number(trimmed) : null;
};

/**
 * Moves the page to a 1-based position within its own list: the top level
 * (where a folder takes one slot) or the folder holding it. Positions below
 * 1 move it to the start, positions past the end move it to the end.
 */
export const movePageToPosition = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pageId: string,
  position: number,
): PageTree => {
  const folder = getPageFolder(tree, pageId);
  const clampIndex = (length: number) =>
    Math.min(Math.max(position, 1), length + 1) - 1;

  if (folder) {
    const rest = folder.pageIds.filter((id) => id !== pageId);
    const pageIds = insertAt(rest, clampIndex(rest.length), pageId);
    return tree.map((node) => (node === folder ? { ...folder, pageIds } : node));
  }
  const node = tree.find(
    (candidate) => candidate.type === "page" && candidate.pageId === pageId,
  )!;
  const rest = tree.filter((candidate) => candidate !== node);
  return insertAt(rest, clampIndex(rest.length), node);
};

/**
 * Moves a page or folder next to the target, in the target's list. Pages can
 * move into and out of folders this way; folders stay at the top level (a
 * folder dropped next to a page in a folder lands next to that folder).
 * Folders left empty are removed.
 */
export const moveNavItem = (
  tree: PageTree,
  dragged: PageNavRef,
  target: PageNavRef,
  placement: PageDropPlacement,
): PageTree => {
  for (const ref of [dragged, target]) {
    if (ref.type === "page") {
      assertPageInTree(tree, ref.id);
    } else {
      findFolder(tree, ref.id);
    }
  }
  if (dragged.type === target.type && dragged.id === target.id) {
    return tree;
  }

  const offset = placement === "after" ? 1 : 0;
  const topLevelIndex = (nodes: PageTree, ref: PageNavRef) =>
    nodes.findIndex((node) =>
      ref.type === "page"
        ? node.type === "page" && node.pageId === ref.id
        : node.type === "folder" && node.id === ref.id,
    );

  if (dragged.type === "folder") {
    const folder = findFolder(tree, dragged.id);
    const targetFolder =
      target.type === "page" ? getPageFolder(tree, target.id) : null;
    const anchor: PageNavRef = targetFolder
      ? { type: "folder", id: targetFolder.id }
      : target;
    if (anchor.type === "folder" && anchor.id === folder.id) {
      return tree;
    }
    const rest = tree.filter((node) => node !== folder);
    return insertAt(rest, topLevelIndex(rest, anchor) + offset, folder);
  }

  const rest = removePage(tree, dragged.id);
  const node: PageNavNode = { type: "page", pageId: dragged.id };
  const targetFolder =
    target.type === "page" ? getPageFolder(rest, target.id) : null;

  let next: PageTree;
  if (targetFolder) {
    const index = targetFolder.pageIds.indexOf(target.id) + offset;
    next = rest.map((candidate) =>
      candidate === targetFolder
        ? {
            ...targetFolder,
            pageIds: insertAt(targetFolder.pageIds, index, dragged.id),
          }
        : candidate,
    );
  } else {
    next = insertAt(rest, topLevelIndex(rest, target) + offset, node);
  }
  return pruneEmptyFolders(next);
};

/**
 * Groups the pages into a new, expanded folder at the end of the top level.
 * Pages keep their relative order and leave any folder they were in.
 */
export const createPageFolder = (
  tree: PageTree,
  pageIds: readonly string[],
  folderId: string,
  name: string,
): PageTree => {
  const trimmedName = name.trim();
  if (!trimmedName) {
    throw new Error("Page folders need a name");
  }
  if (!pageIds.length) {
    throw new Error("No pages selected for the folder");
  }
  pageIds.forEach((id) => assertPageInTree(tree, id));

  const selected = new Set(pageIds);
  const orderedIds = getPageOrder(tree).filter((id) => selected.has(id));
  const rest = pruneEmptyFolders(
    orderedIds.reduce((nodes, id) => removePage(nodes, id), tree),
  );
  return [
    ...rest,
    {
      type: "folder",
      id: folderId,
      name: trimmedName,
      collapsed: false,
      pageIds: orderedIds,
    },
  ];
};

export const togglePageFolder = (
  tree: PageTree,
  folderId: string,
): PageTree => {
  const folder = findFolder(tree, folderId);
  return tree.map((node) =>
    node === folder ? { ...folder, collapsed: !folder.collapsed } : node,
  );
};

const areEqual = (prevProps: LayerUIProps, nextProps: LayerUIProps) => {
  // short-circuit early
  if (prevProps.children !== nextProps.children) {
    return false;
  }

  const { canvas: _pC, appState: prevAppState, ...prev } = prevProps;
  const { canvas: _nC, appState: nextAppState, ...next } = nextProps;

  return (
    isShallowEqual(
      // asserting AppState because we're being passed the whole AppState
      // but resolve to only the UI-relevant props
      stripIrrelevantAppStateProps(prevAppState as AppState),
      stripIrrelevantAppStateProps(nextAppState as AppState),
      {
        selectedElementIds: isShallowEqual,
        selectedGroupIds: isShallowEqual,
      },
    ) && isShallowEqual(prev, next)
  );
};

export default React.memo(LayerUI, areEqual);

type DropTarget = { ref: PageNavRef; placement: PageDropPlacement };

export const Pages = ({

}: {
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[];
  activePageId: string;
  appState: UIAppState;
  files: BinaryFiles;
  onSelectPage: (pageId: string) => void;
  onCreatePage: () => void;
  /** `null` when not in clearing mode */
  clearingSelection: readonly string[] | null;
  onEnterClearingMode: () => void;
  onExitClearingMode: () => void;

  /** navigation order and folders (#162); `pages` is in its flattened order */
  pageTree: PageTree;
  /** returns whether the input was valid (and the page moved) */
  onMoveCurrentPageToPosition: (input: string) => boolean;
  onMoveNavItem: (
    dragged: PageNavRef,

    placement: PageDropPlacement,
  ) => void;
  onCreateFolder: (pageIds: readonly string[], name: string) => void;
  onToggleFolder: (folderId: string) => void;
}) => {
  // local state so the confirmation is scoped to this editor instance
  const [isConfirmingClear, setIsConfirmingClear] = useState(false);
  const isClearing = clearingSelection !== null;
  // deleting mode (#158) reuses clearing mode's page selection
  const isDeleting = isClearing && selectionMode === "delete";
  const selectedCount = clearingSelection
    ? pages.filter((page) => clearingSelection.includes(page.id)).length
    : 0;
  // there is always at least one page
  const allSelected = selectedCount === pages.length;
  const canOrganize = !isClearing && !appState.viewModeEnabled;

  // Shift + drag reordering (#162)
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState<PageNavRef | null>(null);
  const [dropTarget, setDropTarget] = useState<DropTarget | null>(null);
  // read by the window listeners, which are bound once per drag
  const dropTargetRef = useRef<DropTarget | null>(null);
  dropTargetRef.current = dropTarget;

  // Shift + right-click folder selection (#162)
  const [folderSelection, setFolderSelection] = useState<readonly string[]>(
    [],

  const [folderName, setFolderName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [moveInput, setMoveInput] = useState("");

  const validFolderSelection = folderSelection.filter((id) =>
    pages.some((page) => page.id === id),

  const folderCount = pageTree.filter((node) => node.type === "folder").length;
  const defaultFolderName = t("labels.defaultFolderName", {
    number: folderCount + 1,
  });
  const currentFolderName = folderName ?? defaultFolderName;

  // never carry a pending confirmation into or out of clearing mode
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsConfirmingClear(false);

    if (!canOrganize) {
      setDrag(null);
      setDropTarget(null);
      setFolderSelection([]);
      setFolderName(null);

    if (!drag) {

    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);

    );
  };

  const resetFolderSelection = () => {
    setFolderSelection([]);
    setFolderName(null);
  };

  const pagesById = new Map(pages.map((page) => [page.id, page]));

  const renderPage = (pageId: string) => {
    const page = pagesById.get(pageId);
    if (!page) {
      return null;
    }
    const ref: PageNavRef = { type: "page", id: page.id };
    const isActive = page.id === activePageId;
    const isSelected = !!clearingSelection?.includes(page.id);
    const isFolderSelected = validFolderSelection.includes(page.id);
    const title = getPageLabel(page);
    const content = (
      <>
        <PagePreview page={page} files={files} appState={appState} />
        <span className="page-navigation__item-title">
          {(isClearing || isFolderSelected) && (
            <span
              className={clsx("page-navigation__checkbox", {
                "page-navigation__checkbox--checked": isSelected,
                "page-navigation__checkbox--folder": isFolderSelected,
              })}
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              {isSelected || isFolderSelected ? "✓" : ""}
            </span>
          )}
          {title}
          {isClearing && isActive && (
            <span className="page-navigation__current-badge">
              {t("labels.currentPage")}
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
      </>
    );

    return isClearing ? (
      <button
        type="button"
        key={page.id}
        role="checkbox"
        className={clsx("page-navigation__item", {
          "page-navigation__item--current": isActive,
          "page-navigation__item--selected": isSelected,
        })}
        aria-label={title}
        aria-checked={isSelected}
        aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
        onClick={() => onTogglePageForClearing(page.id)}
      >
        {content}
      </button>
    ) : (
      <button
        type="button"
        key={page.id}
        className={clsx("page-navigation__item", getDragClassNames(ref), {
          "page-navigation__item--folder-selected": isFolderSelected,
        })}
        aria-label={title}
        aria-pressed={isActive}
        data-page-id={page.id}
        data-folder-selected={isFolderSelected || undefined}
        onClick={(event) => {
          // Shift + click starts a drag; it never switches pages
          if (!event.shiftKey) {
            onSelectPage(page.id);
          }
        }}
        onContextMenu={(event) => {
          if (event.shiftKey && canOrganize) {
            event.preventDefault();
            toggleFolderSelection(page.id);
          }
        }}
        {...getDragProps(ref)}
      >
        {content}
      </button>
    );
  };

  const renderFolder = (folder: PageFolder) => {
    const ref: PageNavRef = { type: "folder", id: folder.id };
    return (
      <div
        key={folder.id}
        className="page-navigation__folder"
        role="group"
        aria-label={folder.name}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className={clsx(
            "page-navigation__folder-header",
            getDragClassNames(ref),
          )}
          aria-expanded={!folder.collapsed}
          aria-label={folder.name}
          data-folder-id={folder.id}
          onClick={(event) => {
            if (!event.shiftKey) {
              onToggleFolder(folder.id);
            }
          }}
          {...(isClearing ? {} : getDragProps(ref))}
        >
          <span className="page-navigation__folder-chevron" aria-hidden="true">
            {folder.collapsed ? "▸" : "▾"}
          </span>
          <span className="page-navigation__folder-name">{folder.name}</span>
          <span className="page-navigation__folder-count">
            {folder.pageIds.length}
          </span>
        </button>
        {!folder.collapsed && (
          <div className="page-navigation__folder-pages">
            {folder.pageIds.map(renderPage)}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="page-navigation"
      role="region"
      aria-label={t("labels.pages")}
    >
      {isClearing && (
        <div className="page-navigation__clearing-header">
          {isDeleting ? t("labels.deletingMode") : t("labels.clearingMode")}
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        className={clsx("page-navigation__list", {
          "page-navigation__list--dragging": !!drag,
        })}
      >
        {pageTree.map((node) =>
          node.type === "page" ? renderPage(node.pageId) : renderFolder(node),
        )}
      </div>
      {isClearing ? (
        <div className="page-navigation__actions">
          <div className="page-navigation__actions-row">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="page-navigation__add"
              onClick={() => onSetAllPagesForClearing(!allSelected)}
            >
              {allSelected
                ? t("buttons.deselectAllPages")
                : t("buttons.selectAllPages")}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="page-navigation__add"
              onClick={() =>
                onSetPageSelection(
                  pages
                    .filter((page) => page.id !== activePageId)
                    .map((page) => page.id),
                )
              }
              disabled={pages.length < 2}
            >
              {t("buttons.selectOtherPages")}
            </button>
          </div>
          <PageRangeSelect pages={pages} onSelect={onSetPageSelection} />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add page-navigation__add--danger"
            onClick={() => setIsConfirmingClear(true)}
            disabled={!selectedCount || appState.viewModeEnabled}
          >
            {isDeleting ? t("labels.delete") : t("buttons.clearPages")}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add"
            onClick={onExitClearingMode}
          >
            {isDeleting
              ? t("buttons.exitDeletingMode")
              : t("buttons.exitClearingMode")}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="page-navigation__actions">
          {canOrganize && validFolderSelection.length > 0 ? (
            <form
              className="page-folder-create"
              onSubmit={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                if (currentFolderName.trim()) {
                  onCreateFolder(validFolderSelection, currentFolderName);
                  resetFolderSelection();
                }
              }}
            >
              <p className="page-folder-create__label">
                {t("labels.pagesSelectedForFolder", {
                  count: validFolderSelection.length,
                })}
              </p>
              <input
                type="text"
                className="page-range-select__input"
                aria-label={t("labels.folderName")}
                value={currentFolderName}
                onChange={(event) => setFolderName(event.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={!currentFolderName.trim()}
              />
              <div className="page-navigation__actions-row">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="page-navigation__add"
                  disabled={!currentFolderName.trim()}
                >
                  {t("buttons.createFolder")}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="page-navigation__add"
                  onClick={resetFolderSelection}
                >
                  {t("buttons.cancel")}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          ) : (
            <p className="page-navigation__hint">
              {t("labels.pageOrganizeHint")}
            </p>
          )}
          <form
            className="page-range-select"
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              if (onMoveCurrentPageToPosition(moveInput)) {
                setMoveInput("");
              }
            }}
          >
            <div className="page-navigation__actions-row">
              <input
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                className="page-range-select__input"
                value={moveInput}
                aria-label={t("labels.movePageTo")}
                placeholder={t("labels.movePageToPlaceholder")}
                onChange={(event) => setMoveInput(event.target.value)}
                disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="page-navigation__add"
                disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
              >
                {t("buttons.movePage")}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add"
            onClick={onCreatePage}
            disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
          >
            <span aria-hidden="true">+</span>
            {t("buttons.addPage")}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add"
            onClick={onEnterClearingMode}
            disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
          >
            {t("buttons.enterClearingMode")}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add"
            onClick={onEnterDeletingMode}
            disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
          >
            {t("buttons.enterDeletingMode")}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {isDeleting && isConfirmingClear && (
        <PageDeleteDialog
          pages={pages}
          pageIds={clearingSelection}
          onConfirm={() => {
            setIsConfirmingClear(false);
            onDeleteSelectedPages();
          }}
          onCancel={() => setIsConfirmingClear(false)}
        />
      )}
      {isClearing && !isDeleting && isConfirmingClear && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={t("clearPagesDialog.title")}
          confirmText={t("buttons.clearPages")}
          onConfirm={() => {
            setIsConfirmingClear(false);
            onClearSelectedPages();
          }}
          onCancel={() => setIsConfirmingClear(false)}
        >
          <p>{t("clearPagesDialog.content", { count: selectedCount })}</p>
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export { PageIcon };

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

import clsx from "clsx";

import { KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";
import { isNonDeletedElement } from "@excalidraw/element";

import { exportToCanvas } from "../scene/export";

import { getDefaultAppState } from "../appState";
import { t } from "../i18n";
import { getPageLabel } from "../pages";

import ConfirmDialog from "./ConfirmDialog";
import { PageDeleteDialog } from "./PageDeleteDialog";
import { PageRangeSelect } from "./PageRangeSelect";

import "./Pages.scss";

import type { BinaryFiles, UIAppState } from "../types";
import type {
  DrawingPage,
  PageDropPlacement,
  PageFolder,
  PageNavRef,
  PageTree,
} from "../pages";

const PAGE_PREVIEW_WIDTH = 144;
const PAGE_PREVIEW_HEIGHT = 96;

const PageIcon = () => (
  <svg
    aria-hidden="true"
    width="20"
    height="20"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    strokeWidth="1.5"
    strokeLinecap="round"
    strokeLinejoin="round"
  >
    <rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="2" />
    <path d="M8 8h8M8 12h8M8 16h5" />
  </svg>
);

const PagePreview = React.memo(
  ({
    page,
    files,
    appState,
  }: {
    page: DrawingPage;
    files: BinaryFiles;
    appState: UIAppState;
  }) => {
    const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      let active = true;
      const elements = page.elements.filter(isNonDeletedElement);

      if (!elements.length) {
        setPreviewUrl(null);
        return;
      }

      const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
        const defaultAppState = getDefaultAppState();
        const previewAppState = {
          ...defaultAppState,
          ...appState,
          ...page.settings,
          width: appState.width,
          height: appState.height,
          offsetTop: 0,
          offsetLeft: 0,
          scrollX: 0,
          scrollY: 0,
          zoom: defaultAppState.zoom,
        };

        void exportToCanvas(
          elements,
          previewAppState,
          files,
          {
            exportBackground: true,
            exportPadding: 8,
            viewBackgroundColor: page.settings.viewBackgroundColor,
          },
          (width, height) => {
            const scale = Math.min(
              PAGE_PREVIEW_WIDTH / Math.max(width, 1),
              PAGE_PREVIEW_HEIGHT / Math.max(height, 1),
              1,
            );
            const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
            canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(width * scale));
            canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(height * scale));
            return { canvas, scale };
          },
        )
          .then((canvas) => {
            if (active) {
              setPreviewUrl(canvas.toDataURL());
            }
          })
          .catch((error: unknown) => {
            console.error("Failed to render page preview", error);
          });
      }, 250);

      return () => {
        active = false;
        window.clearTimeout(timeout);
      };
    }, [appState, files, page]);

    return previewUrl ? (
      <img className="page-navigation__preview" src={previewUrl} alt="" />
    ) : (
      <span
        className="page-navigation__preview page-navigation__preview--empty"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
    );
  },
  (prevProps, nextProps) =>
    prevProps.page === nextProps.page &&
    prevProps.files === nextProps.files &&
    prevProps.appState.exportWithDarkMode ===
      nextProps.appState.exportWithDarkMode &&
    prevProps.appState.theme === nextProps.appState.theme,
);

type DropTarget = { ref: PageNavRef; placement: PageDropPlacement };

const isSameRef = (a: PageNavRef | null | undefined, b: PageNavRef) =>
  !!a && a.type === b.type && a.id === b.id;

export const Pages = ({
  pages,
  activePageId,
  appState,
  files,
  onSelectPage,
  onCreatePage,
  clearingSelection,
  onEnterClearingMode,
  onExitClearingMode,
  onTogglePageForClearing,
  onSetAllPagesForClearing,
  onClearSelectedPages,
  selectionMode,
  onEnterDeletingMode,
  onDeleteSelectedPages,
  onSetPageSelection,
  pageTree,
  onMoveCurrentPageToPosition,
  onMoveNavItem,
  onCreateFolder,
  onToggleFolder,
}: {
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[];
  activePageId: string;
  appState: UIAppState;
  files: BinaryFiles;
  onSelectPage: (pageId: string) => void;
  onCreatePage: () => void;
  /** `null` when not in clearing mode */
  clearingSelection: readonly string[] | null;
  onEnterClearingMode: () => void;
  onExitClearingMode: () => void;
  onTogglePageForClearing: (pageId: string) => void;
  onSetAllPagesForClearing: (selected: boolean) => void;
  onClearSelectedPages: () => void;
  /** whether the page selection above is for clearing or deleting */
  selectionMode: "clear" | "delete";
  onEnterDeletingMode: () => void;
  onDeleteSelectedPages: () => void;
  onSetPageSelection: (pageIds: readonly string[]) => void;
  /** navigation order and folders (#162); `pages` is in its flattened order */
  pageTree: PageTree;
  /** returns whether the input was valid (and so the page moved) */
  onMoveCurrentPageToPosition: (input: string) => boolean;
  onMoveNavItem: (
    dragged: PageNavRef,
    target: PageNavRef,
    placement: PageDropPlacement,
  ) => void;
  onCreateFolder: (pageIds: readonly string[], name: string) => void;
  onToggleFolder: (folderId: string) => void;
}) => {
  // local state so the confirmation is scoped to this editor instance
  const [isConfirmingClear, setIsConfirmingClear] = useState(false);
  const isClearing = clearingSelection !== null;
  // deleting mode (#158) reuses clearing mode's page selection
  const isDeleting = isClearing && selectionMode === "delete";
  const selectedCount = clearingSelection
    ? pages.filter((page) => clearingSelection.includes(page.id)).length
    : 0;
  // there is always at least one page
  const allSelected = selectedCount === pages.length;
  // reordering and folders (#162) are off in view mode and page modes
  const canOrganize = !isClearing && !appState.viewModeEnabled;

  // Shift + drag reordering
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState<PageNavRef | null>(null);
  const [dropTarget, setDropTarget] = useState<DropTarget | null>(null);
  // read by the window listeners, which are bound once per drag
  const dropTargetRef = useRef<DropTarget | null>(null);
  dropTargetRef.current = dropTarget;

  // Shift + right-click selection of pages for a new folder
  const [folderSelection, setFolderSelection] = useState<readonly string[]>(
    [],
  );
  // null = the user has not typed a name, so the default name is shown
  const [folderName, setFolderName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [moveInput, setMoveInput] = useState("");

  // pages can be deleted while they are selected for a folder
  const validFolderSelection = folderSelection.filter((id) =>
    pages.some((page) => page.id === id),
  );
  const folderCount = pageTree.filter((node) => node.type === "folder").length;
  const currentFolderName =
    folderName ?? t("labels.defaultFolderName", { number: folderCount + 1 });

  // never carry a pending confirmation into or out of clearing mode
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsConfirmingClear(false);
  }, [isClearing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canOrganize) {
      setDrag(null);
      setDropTarget(null);
      setFolderSelection([]);
      setFolderName(null);
    }
  }, [canOrganize]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!drag) {
      return;
    }
    const endDrag = () => {
      setDrag(null);
      setDropTarget(null);
    };
    const onPointerUp = () => {
      const target = dropTargetRef.current;
      if (target && !isSameRef(drag, target.ref)) {
        onMoveNavItem(drag, target.ref, target.placement);
      }
      endDrag();
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === KEYS.ESCAPE) {
        endDrag();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp);
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [drag, onMoveNavItem]);

  const getDragProps = (ref: PageNavRef) => ({
    onPointerDown: (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      if (!canOrganize || !event.shiftKey || event.button !== 0) {
        return;
      }
      // no text selection or focus change while dragging
      event.preventDefault();
      setDrag(ref);
      setDropTarget(null);
    },
    onPointerMove: (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      if (!drag) {
        return;
      }
      const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
      const placement: PageDropPlacement =
        event.clientY > rect.top + rect.height / 2 ? "after" : "before";
      if (
        !isSameRef(dropTarget?.ref, ref) ||
        dropTarget?.placement !== placement
      ) {
        setDropTarget({ ref, placement });
      }
    },
  });

  const getDragClassNames = (ref: PageNavRef) => {
    const isDropTarget =
      !!drag && !isSameRef(drag, ref) && isSameRef(dropTarget?.ref, ref);
    return {
      "page-navigation__item--dragging": isSameRef(drag, ref),
      "page-navigation__item--drop-before":
        isDropTarget && dropTarget?.placement === "before",
      "page-navigation__item--drop-after":
        isDropTarget && dropTarget?.placement === "after",
    };
  };

  const toggleFolderSelection = (pageId: string) => {
    setFolderSelection((selection) =>
      selection.includes(pageId)
        ? selection.filter((id) => id !== pageId)
        : [...selection, pageId],
    );
  };

  const resetFolderSelection = () => {
    setFolderSelection([]);
    setFolderName(null);
  };

  const pagesById = new Map(pages.map((page) => [page.id, page]));

  const renderPage = (pageId: string) => {
    const page = pagesById.get(pageId);
    if (!page) {
      return null;
    }
    const ref: PageNavRef = { type: "page", id: page.id };
    const isActive = page.id === activePageId;
    const isSelected = !!clearingSelection?.includes(page.id);
    const isFolderSelected = validFolderSelection.includes(page.id);
    const title = getPageLabel(page);
    const content = (
      <>
        <PagePreview page={page} files={files} appState={appState} />
        <span className="page-navigation__item-title">
          {(isClearing || isFolderSelected) && (
            <span
              className={clsx("page-navigation__checkbox", {
                "page-navigation__checkbox--checked": isSelected,
                "page-navigation__checkbox--folder": isFolderSelected,
              })}
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              {isSelected || isFolderSelected ? "✓" : ""}
            </span>
          )}
          {title}
          {isClearing && isActive && (
            <span className="page-navigation__current-badge">
              {t("labels.currentPage")}
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
      </>
    );

    return isClearing ? (
      <button
        type="button"
        key={page.id}
        role="checkbox"
        className={clsx("page-navigation__item", {
          "page-navigation__item--current": isActive,
          "page-navigation__item--selected": isSelected,
        })}
        aria-label={title}
        aria-checked={isSelected}
        aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
        onClick={() => onTogglePageForClearing(page.id)}
      >
        {content}
      </button>
    ) : (
      <button
        type="button"
        key={page.id}
        className={clsx("page-navigation__item", getDragClassNames(ref), {
          "page-navigation__item--folder-selected": isFolderSelected,
        })}
        aria-label={title}
        aria-pressed={isActive}
        data-folder-selected={isFolderSelected || undefined}
        onClick={(event) => {
          // Shift + click belongs to dragging; it never switches pages
          if (!event.shiftKey) {
            onSelectPage(page.id);
          }
        }}
        onContextMenu={(event) => {
          if (event.shiftKey && canOrganize) {
            event.preventDefault();
            toggleFolderSelection(page.id);
          }
        }}
        {...getDragProps(ref)}
      >
        {content}
      </button>
    );
  };

  const renderFolder = (folder: PageFolder) => {
    const ref: PageNavRef = { type: "folder", id: folder.id };
    return (
      <div
        key={folder.id}
        className="page-navigation__folder"
        role="group"
        aria-label={folder.name}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className={clsx(
            "page-navigation__folder-header",
            getDragClassNames(ref),
          )}
          aria-expanded={!folder.collapsed}
          aria-label={folder.name}
          onClick={(event) => {
            if (!event.shiftKey) {
              onToggleFolder(folder.id);
            }
          }}
          {...getDragProps(ref)}
        >
          <span className="page-navigation__folder-chevron" aria-hidden="true">
            {folder.collapsed ? "▸" : "▾"}
          </span>
          <span className="page-navigation__folder-name">{folder.name}</span>
          <span className="page-navigation__folder-count" aria-hidden="true">
            {folder.pageIds.length}
          </span>
        </button>
        {!folder.collapsed && (
          <div className="page-navigation__folder-pages">
            {folder.pageIds.map(renderPage)}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="page-navigation"
      role="region"
      aria-label={t("labels.pages")}
    >
      {isClearing && (
        <div className="page-navigation__clearing-header">
          {isDeleting ? t("labels.deletingMode") : t("labels.clearingMode")}
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        className={clsx("page-navigation__list", {
          "page-navigation__list--dragging": !!drag,
        })}
      >
        {pageTree.map((node) =>
          node.type === "page" ? renderPage(node.pageId) : renderFolder(node),
        )}
      </div>
      {isClearing ? (
        <div className="page-navigation__actions">
          <div className="page-navigation__actions-row">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="page-navigation__add"
              onClick={() => onSetAllPagesForClearing(!allSelected)}
            >
              {allSelected
                ? t("buttons.deselectAllPages")
                : t("buttons.selectAllPages")}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="page-navigation__add"
              onClick={() =>
                onSetPageSelection(
                  pages
                    .filter((page) => page.id !== activePageId)
                    .map((page) => page.id),
                )
              }
              disabled={pages.length < 2}
            >
              {t("buttons.selectOtherPages")}
            </button>
          </div>
          <PageRangeSelect pages={pages} onSelect={onSetPageSelection} />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add page-navigation__add--danger"
            onClick={() => setIsConfirmingClear(true)}
            disabled={!selectedCount || appState.viewModeEnabled}
          >
            {isDeleting ? t("labels.delete") : t("buttons.clearPages")}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add"
            onClick={onExitClearingMode}
          >
            {isDeleting
              ? t("buttons.exitDeletingMode")
              : t("buttons.exitClearingMode")}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="page-navigation__actions">
          {canOrganize && validFolderSelection.length > 0 ? (
            <form
              className="page-folder-create"
              onSubmit={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                if (currentFolderName.trim()) {
                  onCreateFolder(validFolderSelection, currentFolderName);
                  resetFolderSelection();
                }
              }}
            >
              <p className="page-folder-create__label">
                {t("labels.pagesSelectedForFolder", {
                  count: validFolderSelection.length,
                })}
              </p>
              <input
                type="text"
                className="page-range-select__input"
                aria-label={t("labels.folderName")}
                value={currentFolderName}
                onChange={(event) => setFolderName(event.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={!currentFolderName.trim()}
              />
              <div className="page-navigation__actions-row">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="page-navigation__add"
                  disabled={!currentFolderName.trim()}
                >
                  {t("buttons.createFolder")}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="page-navigation__add"
                  onClick={resetFolderSelection}
                >
                  {t("buttons.cancel")}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          ) : (
            !appState.viewModeEnabled && (
              <p className="page-navigation__hint">
                {t("labels.pageOrganizeHint")}
              </p>
            )
          )}
          <form
            className="page-range-select"
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              if (onMoveCurrentPageToPosition(moveInput)) {
                setMoveInput("");
              }
            }}
          >
            <div className="page-navigation__actions-row">
              <input
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                className="page-range-select__input"
                value={moveInput}
                aria-label={t("labels.movePageTo")}
                placeholder={t("labels.movePageToPlaceholder")}
                onChange={(event) => setMoveInput(event.target.value)}
                disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="page-navigation__add"
                disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
              >
                {t("buttons.movePage")}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add"
            onClick={onCreatePage}
            disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
          >
            <span aria-hidden="true">+</span>
            {t("buttons.addPage")}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add"
            onClick={onEnterClearingMode}
            disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
          >
            {t("buttons.enterClearingMode")}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="page-navigation__add"
            onClick={onEnterDeletingMode}
            disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
          >
            {t("buttons.enterDeletingMode")}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {isDeleting && isConfirmingClear && (
        <PageDeleteDialog
          pages={pages}
          pageIds={clearingSelection}
          onConfirm={() => {
            setIsConfirmingClear(false);
            onDeleteSelectedPages();
          }}
          onCancel={() => setIsConfirmingClear(false)}
        />
      )}
      {isClearing && !isDeleting && isConfirmingClear && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          title={t("clearPagesDialog.title")}
          confirmText={t("buttons.clearPages")}
          onConfirm={() => {
            setIsConfirmingClear(false);
            onClearSelectedPages();
          }}
          onCancel={() => setIsConfirmingClear(false)}
        >
          <p>{t("clearPagesDialog.content", { count: selectedCount })}</p>
        </ConfirmDialog>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export { PageIcon };

+const normalizePageName = (name: string) => name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
+
+/**
+ * Returns `${baseName} N` using the smallest N >= 1 whose name isn't already
+ * taken (case-insensitively) by another page.
+ */
+export const getNextDefaultPageName = (
+  pages: readonly Pick<DrawingPage, "name">[],
+  baseName: string,
+): string => {
+  const taken = new Set(pages.map((page) => normalizePageName(page.name)));
+  let index = 1;
+  while (taken.has(normalizePageName(`${baseName} ${index}`))) {
+    index++;
+  }
+  return `${baseName} ${index}`;
+};
+
+export const validatePageInfo = (
+  info: { name: string; description: string },
+  pages: readonly Pick<DrawingPage, "id" | "name">[],
+  pageId: string,
+): PageInfoValidation => {
+  const result: PageInfoValidation = {};
+  const trimmedName = info.name.trim();
+
+  if (!trimmedName) {
+    result.nameError = "empty";
+  } else if (trimmedName.length > PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH) {
+    result.nameError = "tooLong";
+  } else if (
+    pages.some(
+      (page) =>
+        page.id !== pageId &&
+        normalizePageName(page.name) === normalizePageName(trimmedName),
+    )
+  ) {
+    result.nameError = "duplicate";
+  }
+
+  if (info.description.length > PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH) {
+    result.descriptionError = "tooLong";
+  }
+
+  return result;
+};
+
+export const isPageInfoValid = (validation: PageInfoValidation) =>
+  !validation.nameError && !validation.descriptionError;

import { Switch } from "./Switch";
import { TextField } from "./TextField";

import "./PageInfoDialog.scss";

import type { DrawingPage, PageInfoPatch } from "../pages";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";

const getPatchFromPage = (page: DrawingPage): PageInfoPatch => ({
  name: page.name,
  description: page.description,
  showThumbnail: page.showThumbnail,
  grid: {
    gridModeEnabled: page.settings.gridModeEnabled,
    gridSnapEnabled: page.settings.gridSnapEnabled,
    gridSize: page.settings.gridSize,
  },
});

/**
 * Shows a page's name, description and settings, and lets the user edit them.
 * Changes are kept in a local draft until explicitly saved.
 */
export const PageInfoDialog = ({
  page,
  pages,
  onSave,
  onClose,
}: {
  page: DrawingPage;
  pages: readonly DrawingPage[];
  onSave: (patch: PageInfoPatch) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) => {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PageInfoPatch | null>(null);
  // keep the raw text so the field can be cleared while typing
  const [gridSizeInput, setGridSizeInput] = useState("");

  const startEditing = () => {
    const initial = getPatchFromPage(page);
    setDraft(initial);
    setGridSizeInput(String(initial.grid.gridSize));
  };

  const cancelEditing = () => {
    setDraft(null);
  };

  const validation = draft
    ? validatePageInfo(draft, pages, page.id)
    : { nameError: undefined, descriptionError: undefined };
  const canSave = !!draft && isPageInfoValid(validation);

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!draft || !canSave) {
      return;
    }
    onSave({ ...draft, name: draft.name.trim() });
  };

  const handleNameKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (event.key === KEYS.ENTER) {
      event.preventDefault();
      handleSave();
    }
  };

  const updateDraft = (patch: Partial<PageInfoPatch>) => {
    setDraft((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, ...patch } : prev));
  };

  const updateGrid = (patch: Partial<PageInfoPatch["grid"]>) => {
    setDraft((prev) =>
      prev ? { ...prev, grid: { ...prev.grid, ...patch } } : prev,
    );
  };

  const nameErrorMessage =
    validation.nameError === "empty"
      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.emptyName")
      : validation.nameError === "duplicate"
      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.duplicateName")
      : validation.nameError === "tooLong"
      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.nameTooLong", { max: PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH })
      : null;

  const renderView = () => (
    <>
      <dl className="PageInfoDialog__details">
        <dt>{t("pageInfoDialog.name")}</dt>
        <dd className="PageInfoDialog__name">{page.name}</dd>
        {page.description && (
          <>
            <dt>{t("pageInfoDialog.description")}</dt>
            <dd className="PageInfoDialog__description">{page.description}</dd>
          </>
        )}
        <dt>{t("pageInfoDialog.thumbnail")}</dt>
        <dd>
          {page.showThumbnail
            ? t("pageInfoDialog.thumbnailShown")
            : t("pageInfoDialog.thumbnailHidden")}
        </dd>
        <dt>{t("pageInfoDialog.grid")}</dt>
        <dd>
          {page.settings.gridModeEnabled
            ? t("pageInfoDialog.gridShown")
            : t("pageInfoDialog.gridHidden")}
          {" · "}
          {page.settings.gridSnapEnabled
            ? t("pageInfoDialog.snapOn")
            : t("pageInfoDialog.snapOff")}
          {" · "}
          {t("pageInfoDialog.gridSize")}: {page.settings.gridSize}
        </dd>
      </dl>
      <div className="PageInfoDialog__actions">
        <DialogActionButton label={t("buttons.close")} onClick={onClose} />
        <DialogActionButton
          label={t("buttons.edit")}
          onClick={startEditing}
          actionType="primary"
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );

  const renderEdit = (draft: PageInfoPatch) => (
    <>
      <div className="PageInfoDialog__fields">
        <div>
          <TextField
            label={t("pageInfoDialog.name")}
            value={draft.name}
            onChange={(name) => updateDraft({ name })}
            onKeyDown={handleNameKeyDown}
            selectOnRender
            fullWidth
          />
          {nameErrorMessage && (
            <div className="PageInfoDialog__error" role="alert">
              {nameErrorMessage}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <label className="PageInfoDialog__textarea">
          <span className="PageInfoDialog__label">
            {t("pageInfoDialog.description")}
          </span>
          <textarea
            value={draft.description}
            placeholder={t("pageInfoDialog.descriptionPlaceholder")}
            rows={4}
            onChange={(event) =>
              updateDraft({ description: event.target.value })
            }
            aria-invalid={!!validation.descriptionError}
          />
          <span
            className={
              validation.descriptionError
                ? "PageInfoDialog__counter PageInfoDialog__counter--error"
                : "PageInfoDialog__counter"
            }
          >
            {t("pageInfoDialog.charCount", {
              count: draft.description.length,
              max: PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
            })}
          </span>
          {validation.descriptionError && (
            <span className="PageInfoDialog__error" role="alert">
              {t("pageInfoDialog.errors.descriptionTooLong", {
                max: PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
              })}
            </span>
          )}
        </label>
        <CheckboxItem
          checked={draft.showThumbnail}
          onChange={(showThumbnail) => updateDraft({ showThumbnail })}
        >
          {t("pageInfoDialog.showThumbnail")}
        </CheckboxItem>
        <fieldset className="PageInfoDialog__grid">
          <legend>{t("pageInfoDialog.grid")}</legend>
          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.showGrid")}</span>
            <Switch
              name="page-info-grid-mode"
              title={t("pageInfoDialog.showGrid")}
              checked={draft.grid.gridModeEnabled}
              onChange={(gridModeEnabled) => updateGrid({ gridModeEnabled })}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.snapToGrid")}</span>
            <Switch
              name="page-info-grid-snap"
              title={t("pageInfoDialog.snapToGrid")}
              checked={draft.grid.gridSnapEnabled}
              onChange={(gridSnapEnabled) => updateGrid({ gridSnapEnabled })}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.gridSize")}</span>
            <input
              className="PageInfoDialog__number"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={100}
              value={gridSizeInput}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setGridSizeInput(event.target.value);
                const value = Number(event.target.value);
                if (event.target.value !== "" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
                  updateGrid({ gridSize: getNormalizedGridSize(value) });
                }
              }}
              onBlur={() => setGridSizeInput(String(draft.grid.gridSize))}
            />
          </label>
        </fieldset>
      </div>
      <div className="PageInfoDialog__actions">
        <DialogActionButton
          label={t("buttons.cancel")}
          onClick={cancelEditing}
        />
        <DialogActionButton
          label={t("pageInfoDialog.save")}
          onClick={handleSave}
          actionType="primary"
          disabled={!canSave}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <Dialog
      size="small"
      onCloseRequest={onClose}
      title={t("pageInfoDialog.title")}
      className="PageInfoDialog"
    >
      {draft ? renderEdit(draft) : renderView()}
    </Dialog>
  );
};

  public updatePageInfo = (pageId: string, patch: PageInfoPatch) => {
    const target = this.pages.find((page) => page.id === pageId);
    if (!target) {
      return;
    }

    const name = patch.name.trim();
    const validation = validatePageInfo(
      { name, description: patch.description },
      this.pages,
      pageId,
    );
    if (!isPageInfoValid(validation)) {
      return;
    }

    const isActive = pageId === this.activePageId;
    const currentSettings = isActive
      ? getPageSettings(this.state)
      : target.settings;
    const gridSettings = {
      ...patch.grid,
      // opacity 0 hid the grid, so showing it again starts fully visible
      gridOpacity:
        patch.grid.gridModeEnabled && currentSettings.gridOpacity === 0
          ? DEFAULT_GRID_OPACITY
          : currentSettings.gridOpacity,
    };

    this.pages = this.pages.map((page) =>
      page.id === pageId
        ? {
            ...page,
            name,
            description: patch.description,
            showThumbnail: patch.showThumbnail,
            // the active page's settings live in this.state and are written
            // back by saveActivePage(), so only inactive pages update here
            settings: isActive
              ? page.settings
              : { ...page.settings, ...gridSettings },
          }
        : page,
    );

    if (isActive) {
      this.setState({ ...gridSettings, openDialog: null });
    } else {
      this.setState({ openDialog: null });
    }
  };

    );

    this.pages = [...this.pages, page];
    this.activePageId = page.id;
    this.history.clear();
    this.updateScene({
      elements: page.elements,
      appState: getPageActivationAppState(page.settings),
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    });
  };

I added both actions. The typecheck is clean, and both page test files pass, old tests and new ones.

**Delete folder:** each folder header now has a **×** button next to it. It removes only the folder: the folder's pages go back to the top level, in order, where the folder was. It deletes no pages, since deleting pages is out of scope for #162. The button is hidden in view mode and in clearing/deleting mode.

**Remove page from folder:** for a page inside a folder, its page info menu (right-click or F2) now has a **Remove from folder** button. It puts the page at the top level right after its folder, and a folder left empty disappears. Shift+dragging a page out of a folder still works too.

**Changes after the #160 merge:** I fast-forwarded the branch onto the new master and reapplied #162 on top of it:
- **No page numbers:** I dropped the stable-number field I'd planned. #160's page names already stay the same when pages are reordered.
- **Move by number:** this now lives in #160's page info menu instead of the sidebar actions area. That's where the issue text puts it ("page tab menu"), and it can move any page, not just the current one. The menu also shows "Position N of M". The number counts within the page's own list: the top level (where a folder takes one slot) or its folder.
- **Right-click on a tab:** a plain right-click still opens the page info menu. Shift+right-click selects the page for a new folder.

The issue's criteria:

| Criterion | Status |
|---|---|
| A: Shift+drag and move by number | Works and is tested |
| B: Shift+right-click, then name and create a folder | Works and is tested |
| C: folders go last, can be dragged, collapse and expand | Works and is tested |
| D: a number past the end moves the page to the end | Works and is tested |
| E: 0 moves the page to the start | Works and is tested |
| F: negative or non-numeric input shows a notification and nothing moves | Works and is tested |

Two limits: folder order isn't saved, because saving pages is out of scope. Reordering can't be undone, because the undo history only covers the active page.
